purpose: Human-readable and machine-testable catalog of Buddy tools and skills: what each does, whether DreamCo needs it, and how Buddy should use it to train or test other AI models.

evidencePolicy.noHallucinationRule: Buddy must cite a command, report path, source URL, or explicit not-verified note before claiming a tool or skill works.

tools.name: GitHub Repository Reader
tools.whatItDoes: Reads files, issues, pull requests, workflows, and repository structure so Buddy can understand DreamCo before acting.
tools.howToUse: Use for code search, issue comparison, audit evidence, and training other AI models on public repository context.

tools.name: GitHub Repository Writer
tools.whatItDoes: Creates or updates repository files after approval.
tools.howToUse: Use only after Buddy drafts a plan and owner approval is granted. Prefer pull requests for large changes.

tools.name: Sandbox No-Hallucination Audit
tools.whatItDoes: Checks repo evidence, syntax, JSON validity, and unsupported absolute claims.
tools.howToUse: Run before Buddy claims bots, tools, skills, customer systems, or dashboards are ready. Keep report evidence before marking any claim verified.

tools.name: Autonomous Readiness Audit
tools.whatItDoes: Validates semi-autonomous cash-loop, social, occupational, tool finder, skill finder, and Buddy chat readiness files.
tools.howToUse: Run before enabling customer discovery, social drafts, tool discovery, or skill-building workflows. Owner approval is required before activating customer contact, social posting, or money workflows.

tools.name: Tool Finder Bot
tools.whatItDoes: Finds useful public tools, GitHub repositories, official docs, package registry entries, workflows, and MCP servers.
tools.howToUse: Use to research tools for each division, then score fit, security, cost, documentation, maintenance, and integration effort.

tools.name: Tool Builder Bot
tools.whatItDoes: Turns repeated needs into internal tools, templates, scripts, dashboards, workflows, or GitHub Actions.
tools.howToUse: Use after Tool Finder identifies a gap. Builds should require approval before file writes or dependency installs.

tools.name: Skill Finder Bot
tools.whatItDoes: Finds job skills, playbooks, public references, training topics, and methods from sourced public information.
tools.howToUse: Use for occupational bots and model training plans. Store source, confidence, usable knowledge, and next experiment.

tools.name: Skill Builder Bot
tools.whatItDoes: Converts validated skills into prompts, tests, checklists, lessons, and training paths.
tools.howToUse: Use only after Skill Finder provides sourced evidence. Do not train external models with private data without approval.

tools.name: Social Media Draft Studio
tools.whatItDoes: Drafts social posts, campaigns, ad ideas, content calendars, and platform-specific copy.
tools.howToUse: Use in draft-only mode until platform secrets and owner approval are configured.

tools.name: Customer Discovery
tools.whatItDoes: Finds customer segments, researches public signals, scores fit, drafts outreach, and creates CRM-ready lead notes.
tools.howToUse: Use for real estate, Fiverr/services, lead generation, and occupational bots. Human approval is required before contact.

skills.name: Evidence-Based Reporting
skills.whatItDoes: Forces Buddy to say what was tested, what was not verified, and what evidence supports each claim.
skills.howToUse: Use in every final report, dashboard status, and training handoff.

skills.name: Customer Problem Mapping
skills.whatItDoes: Maps a customer type to pain points, offer ideas, MVP tests, pricing, and KPIs.
skills.howToUse: Use before lead gen, real estate outreach, Fiverr gig building, or sales campaigns. Human approval is required before outreach, pricing promises, or customer contact.

skills.name: Occupational Efficiency Mapping
skills.whatItDoes: Studies a job or hustle category and identifies how bots can make humans faster, safer, or more profitable.
skills.howToUse: Use for occupational bot workers and job-family training paths.

skills.name: Sourced Memory Curation
skills.whatItDoes: Stores learned information with source URL, confidence, usable knowledge, and next experiment.
skills.howToUse: Use whenever Buddy teaches another AI model or updates a bot learning path.

skills.name: Model Training Handoff
skills.whatItDoes: Packages DreamCo knowledge into clean prompts, examples, tests, and evaluation rubrics for other AI models.
skills.howToUse: Use only with approved public/safe data. Never include secrets, private customer data, or unsourced claims.
